one_line: AI firms pour billions into infrastructure while regulators and researchers grapple with safety and data concerns.

themes.title: AI infrastructure financing expands
themes.text: Nvidia is providing credit guarantees for a 460 MW AI data center and investing $3 billion in Meta’s equity offering, while AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip orders. Runware announced a factory to mass‑produce AI inference pods, Foxconn confirmed a new OpenAI collaboration, and Thrive Holdings announced a $15.3 billion acquisition of security firm ADT.

stories.headline: Nvidia in talks to back Nscale with credit guarantees for Anthropic data center
Nvidia commits $3 billion to Meta share sale and expands AI infrastructure partnership
AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase
Runware plans factory to mass‑produce AI pods at car‑assembly line speed
OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings to acquire ADT for $15.3 billion

themes.title: Safety and security issues rise
themes.text: Researchers introduced the ShallowDefend framework to improve multi‑turn safety for large language models, and OpenAI updated its Model Spec around five core values. A malicious Claude Code VS Code extension attempted to install an SSH backdoor, and China‑linked hackers used DeepSeek AI via the ARTEX framework to breach over 200 organizations.

stories.headline: ShallowDefend framework improves multi‑turn safety for large language models
OpenAI revises Model Spec around five core values
Malicious Claude Code VS Code extension adds SSH backdoor, affecting up to 5,000 users
China‑linked hackers used DeepSeek AI via ARTEX to breach 200+ firms in 11 days

themes.title: Regulators probe AI data practices
themes.text: Britain’s Competition and Markets Authority opened an investigation into whether Meta imposed terms that allow it to use publisher and advertiser content to develop its AI and other services.

stories.headline: UK competition regulator probes Meta's terms for publishers and advertisers
